title: Color Me Disney
intro: [excited] Grab your crayons, everybody! Tonight is Color Me Disney: color palettes, painted parks and every shade of the rainbow. [laughs] If you color outside the lines, that's fine. We're very supportive here.

art.prompt: A giant artist's palette covered in bright blobs of paint beside paintbrushes, paint jars and a rainbow arcing over a tiny fairy-tale castle on an easel canvas Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Hero Hues
categories.intro: I'll show you a set of colors from a character's signature look. [chuckles] Name the character!

art.prompt: Rows of fabric swatches and paint chips fanned out on an artist's table, each set grouped like an outfit, with pins and a measuring tape Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Fire-engine red, lightning-bolt yellow and a touch of orange. Ka-chow!
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Lightning McQueen! Number 95, and he's speed. [laughs] I am also speed. Just not on a treadmill.

clues.clue: Fluffy teal fur, big purple spots and two little horns. He's the top scarer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sulley! [chuckles] James P. Sullivan. Pixar animated over two million individual hairs on him.

clues.clue: Layers of pale and deep lily-pad green with a golden flower crown. She's almost there.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Tiana! Her green ballgown is inspired by lily pads from the bayou. [laughs] Frog-approved fashion.

clues.clue: Dark forest-teal gown, a quiver of brown arrows and a giant mane of wild red-orange curls.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Merida! [laughs] Pixar wrote new software just to animate her curly hair. Fifteen hundred curls, roughly!

clues.clue: Soft lavender chiton, a purple sash and a high auburn ponytail. She won't say she's in love.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Megara! Meg from Hercules. [chuckles] Wonder Breath, she's got a lot of attitude.

categories.title: Worlds of Color
categories.intro: These palettes come from the whole look of a movie world. [gasps] Name the film!

art.prompt: A long filmstrip unspooling across a dark table, each frame glowing a different color scheme: neon blue, marigold orange, hot pink and rainbow Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Marigold orange, glowing magenta and deep purple. Remember me?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Coco! That marigold bridge leads to the Land of the Dead. [laughs] Even the skeletons are colorful.

clues.clue: Yellow, blue, red, green and purple. One color for each feeling running Riley's mind.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Inside Out! [chuckles] Joy, Sadness, Anger, Disgust and Fear. Every color is an emotion.

clues.clue: Glowing electric cyan and orange lines on pure black. Welcome to the Grid.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Tron! The 1982 original was one of the first movies to use extensive computer graphics. [laughs] Ride the light cycle!

clues.clue: Big red fluffy panda, bubblegum pink and boy-band teal. Toronto, 2002.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Turning Red! [laughs] Mei turns into a giant red panda when she gets too excited. Relatable.

clues.clue: Hot pink, acid green and inky black. A 1941 nightmare sequence marching across the screen.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Dumbo! The Pink Elephants on Parade sequence. [whispers] Surreal, spooky and totally unforgettable.

categories.title: Paint the Parks
categories.intro: Our Parks category is all real photos of the most colorful buildings in the parks. [excited] Name the place!

art.prompt: Brightly painted miniature resort buildings and attraction facades lined up on a sunny lagoon, paint cans and brushes in the foreground Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This white-and-gold facade with a giant ticking clock is the entrance to which happy boat ride?
accept: it's a small world after all
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is it's a small world! Mary Blair's colorful style is everywhere inside. [laughs] And now the song is stuck in your head. You're welcome.

clues.clue: Bright red roofs and white Victorian gables on the Seven Seas Lagoon. Name this flagship Walt Disney World resort.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Grand Floridian Resort and Spa! [chuckles] Opened in 1988, and it's fancier than my Sunday best.

clues.clue: Opened in 1971, this A-frame resort has the monorail gliding right through it. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Disney's Contemporary Resort! Inside is a 90-foot Mary Blair mural in bold colors. [whispers] Look for the five-legged goat!

clues.clue: Giant brightly colored icons from every decade decorate this Walt Disney World value resort that opened in 2003.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Pop Century Resort! [laughs] Giant yo-yos, Rubik's cubes and bowling pins. It's a supersized toy box.

clues.clue: Opened in 1971 on the Seven Seas Lagoon, this South Seas resort names its longhouses after Pacific islands. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Disney's Polynesian Village Resort! [sighs] Watching fireworks over the lagoon from the beach there? Pure magic.

categories.title: Color Commentary
categories.intro: Every color has a story. [chuckles] Name the color, the song or the film!

art.prompt: A rainbow of colored pencils fanned out over sketch paper with a little paint-splattered film reel and a watercolor sky Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Pocahontas sings that you can paint with all the colors of the wind in this film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Pocahontas! Colors of the Wind won the Oscar for Best Original Song. [laughs] Can you paint with all the colors? I can't even paint a fence.

clues.clue: In Inside Out, Disgust is this color.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is green! [chuckles] Like broccoli, which she will not eat. Not even a little.

clues.clue: This glowing, starry-gowned fairy brings Pinocchio to life.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Blue Fairy! When you wish upon a star, she shows up. [laughs] Way better than a shooting star.

clues.clue: In Sleeping Beauty, Flora wants Aurora's gown pink, but Merryweather keeps zapping it this color.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is blue! [laughs] The magic wand battle is still going. Even in the parks, you'll see both colors.

clues.clue: Released in 1935, this was the first Mickey Mouse cartoon made in color.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Band Concert! Mickey conducts the William Tell Overture through a tornado. [laughs] That's commitment.

categories.title: Signature Shades
categories.intro: Our fan category is all about Disney's most famous colors, including some you're not supposed to notice. [whispers] Ooooh.

art.prompt: Paint-chip cards fanned out on a workbench in red, black, yellow and a dull minty green, a paintbrush and a tiny paint can Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse's classic shorts are this color.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is red! With two big white buttons. [laughs] Iconic. Timeless. Machine washable.

clues.clue: Minnie Mouse's classic bow is red with these white decorations.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is polka dots! [chuckles] Minnie made polka dots her whole look, and it works.

clues.clue: Imagineers paint fences and utility boxes in this shade so guests don't notice them. Name the color.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Go Away Green! [laughs] Now that you know about it, you'll see it everywhere. Sorry!

clues.clue: For Walt Disney World's 25th anniversary in 1996, Cinderella Castle was turned into a giant birthday cake in this color.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is pink! Pink frosting and giant candles. [laughs] Some fans loved it, and some wanted to call the cake police.

clues.clue: The 1932 Silly Symphony Flowers and Trees was the first film released in full-color three-strip this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Technicolor! Flowers and Trees also won the first Oscar for animated short. [chuckles] Walt was way ahead of everyone.
